onnx.obs_normalization: baked into the ONNX graph: feed RAW observations

actuators.mode: driver-side PD (MIT mode, >= 1 kHz): tau = kp * (q_target - q) - kd * qd, clamped to +/- effort_limit
actuators.knee_max_note: pose-dependent knee limit knee_max(hip_pitch) from robot/model.py (80/90/100/110/120 deg for hip_pitch > 0/-15/-30/-45/else deg) must be enforced by the safety layer

observation.scaling: none (all terms in the units listed)

terms.name: base_ang_vel
terms.description: torso angular velocity [wx, wy, wz] in the torso frame (x forward, y left, z up); raw gyro rotated into the torso frame

terms.name: projected_gravity
terms.description: gravity direction in the torso frame, normalised; (0, 0, -1) when upright (from the IMU orientation estimate: R_world_torso^T @ [0, 0, -1])

terms.name: actions
terms.description: the raw (unscaled, unclipped) action output by the previous policy step; zeros at start

terms.name: command
terms.description: twist command [vx, vy, wz] in the torso heading frame

terms.name: gait_phase
terms.description: [sin(2 pi phi), cos(2 pi phi)] of the gait clock phase phi (see gait_clock)

gait_clock.active_rule: active = (hypot(vx, vy) + abs(wz)) > active_threshold, evaluated on the command fed to the policy at this step
gait_clock.update_rule: every policy step, BEFORE building the observation: if active: phi = (phi + policy_dt_s / period_s) mod 1; else phi unchanged (paused)
gait_clock.observation: gait_phase = [sin(2 pi phi), cos(2 pi phi)]
gait_clock.schedule: left leg swings for phi in [0, swing_fraction), right leg for (phi + 0.5) mod 1 in [0, swing_fraction); otherwise stance; paused -> both stance

commands.standing: command [0, 0, 0] (gait clock pauses, both feet down)
